Click & Collect at Pacific Fair

Yes, you can shop the full Priceline range at priceline.com.au and collect your order from Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair in Broadbeach. Orders are usually ready within 15 minutes, and there’s no delivery fee. Choose Priceline Pacific Fair at checkout and we’ll message you when it’s ready.

Shop priceline.com.au Call (07) 5592 2099

At a glance

What it is
Order from the full Priceline range online and collect in store.
Who it's for
Anyone. Prescription medicines are not available this way.
Cost
No delivery fee.
How long
Usually ready within 15 minutes; within 2 hours at the latest when everything is in stock.
Booking
Order any time.
How to book
Choose Priceline Pacific Fair at checkout on priceline.com.au.

How does Click & Collect work?

  1. Shop online. Go to priceline.com.au and add your items to your cart.
  2. Choose Pacific Fair. At checkout, select Click & Collect and choose Priceline Pacific Fair as your store.
  3. Wait for your message. We’ll let you know when your order is ready. That’s usually within 15 minutes, and within 2 hours at the latest when everything is in stock.
  4. Collect. Show your order confirmation at the counter and we’ll hand it over.

Can I order prescriptions this way?

No. Click & Collect is for general products. Prescription medicines can’t be ordered this way; see prescriptions to send your eScript ahead so it’s ready when you arrive.

Is there a fee for Click & Collect?

There’s no delivery fee, because you’re collecting from us. We’re open 7 days and until 9pm on Thursdays; see opening hours and directions for where to find us in Pacific Fair.

Would you rather have it delivered?

We deliver across the Gold Coast through Uber Eats. See our delivery options.

Common questions

How long until my Click & Collect order is ready?

Usually within 15 minutes, and within 2 hours at the latest when everything is in stock. We’ll send you a message when it’s ready to collect.

Can I order prescription medicines with Click & Collect?

No. Click & Collect is for general products. To have a prescription ready when you arrive, send your eScript ahead through the Priceline Pharmacy app or MedAdvisor instead.

Is there a fee for Click & Collect?

No. There’s no delivery fee, because you’re collecting from us. Just choose Priceline Pacific Fair at checkout.

How do I choose Pacific Fair as my store?

At checkout on priceline.com.au, select Click & Collect and choose Priceline Pacific Fair as your store. Then wait for our message and come in to collect.

What do I need to bring when I collect?

Just your order confirmation. Show it at the counter and we’ll hand your order over.

Can I get my order delivered instead?

Yes. We deliver health, beauty and wellbeing products across the Gold Coast through Uber Eats; delivery fees apply. Search for Priceline Pharmacy Pacific Fair in the Uber Eats app.
